docs: Increment a Beetle Card's score after scoring a pattern
This is called by the backend after successful pattern scoring
The authority must be a trusted scoring authority
HYBRID MODEL: Score tracks effort (eligibility), but does NOT auto-update level.
Level only changes via upgrade_beetle_card instruction (burning DUNG).
The event shows eligible_level to indicate what level the user CAN claim.

instructions.name: upgradeBeetleCard
docs: Upgrade a Beetle Card to the next level (HYBRID model)
HYBRID model requirements:
1. User must have sufficient SCORE (effort threshold) to unlock the level
2. User must burn DUNG to claim the level
Formula: 25 * 2^(current_level - 1) DUNG per level
Level 0->1: 25 DUNG, Level 1->2: 25 DUNG, Level 2->3: 50 DUNG, etc.
Special gates (verified by backend_authority before this instruction is signed):
- Level 5: 50km/week badge
- Level 7: 10 segment challenges
- Level 8: Top 10 any segment
- Level 9: 30-day streak
- Level 10: ELITE GATE (5 KOMs, 4.0 w/kg, 60-day streak, 50K TSS)

instructions.name: getUpgradeCost
docs: Calculate the DUNG cost to upgrade from current level to next level
Formula: 25 * 2^(level-1) DUNG (with level 0->1 being 25 DUNG)
Returns the cost with 9 decimals (e.g., 25_000_000_000 for 25 DUNG)

summed on-chain. Repeating the instruction is a no-op only when the

instructions.name: distributeEpochRewards
docs: Distribute Settlement Week rewards using the canonical policy.
The config argument remains for ABI compatibility, but only the
canonical 55/27/3/5/10 split is accepted.
Distributes DUNG from accumulated CAL tribute to (TOKENOMICS_V2):
- Record Royalty: 55% base, prior record carry, and same-week locked staker share
- Stakers: current-week unlocked share plus prior unlocked pro-rata dust
- 3% Local Legend (single elected curator per vault)
- 5% POL (protocol-owned liquidity)
- 10% Protocol Treasury

docs: Zero means no pending transition; otherwise stores effective week + 1.

fields.name: harvestedUnits
docs: Deployment-wide lifetime accumulator, never reset on exits/fee payment.

fields.name: providerStaleSince
docs: First successful authenticated observation of an expired provider.

fields.name: outageIsOpaque
docs: Authenticated unparseable/impossible state has no native update witness.

fields.name: providerSlots
docs: Real providers use epoch freshness; local fixtures retain seconds.

fields.name: dungStartWeekPlusOne
docs: Zero means disabled; otherwise the configured start week plus one.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Separate emergency signer. It can pause and resume intake and settlement.

fields.name: registrar
docs: Admits ratified climbs and hills only; rotation remains admin-only.

fields.name: foundingCutoff
docs: Membership also requires the lot's bit in the immutable founding mask.

fields.name: quotedNumerators
docs: Current per-slot quotes, frozen at bond; excluded slots have zero rates.

fields.name: foundingLaggingSlots
docs: Prior-epoch quotes retained for founding only; zero bonding-line value.

fields.name: admittedWeek
docs: Settlement starts at admission, never at the city's week zero.

fields.name: dungDepositedBasis
docs: Conservative historical bounds for publisher-attested DUNG openings.
Never compare a past opening to today's (possibly withdrawn) basis.

fields.name: dungLockEnds
docs: Latest ordinary deposit lock end. Complete only when no campaign lot
was excluded at bonding (excluded conversions have a readonly hill).

fields.name: converted
docs: Owner converted an excluded pre-bond lot into ordinary, non-founding stake.

fields.name: ownerUnits
docs: These units have separate token custody and never count as backing.

fields.name: observedLossLamports
docs: Shortfall at the last validated observation, not a promise of recovery.

fields.name: realizedLossLamports
docs: None when returned without a fresh rate; never invent a SOL loss.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 notice, 1 exiting, 2 returned, 3 cancelled. Never reused/closed.

fields.name: metadataHash
docs: H(set address, cap, frozen time, H(full immutable audit fields)).

fields.name: rentPayer
docs: First preparer owns the rent refund, even after publisher rotation.

fields.name: nextWeek
docs: First unprocessed week (all smaller weeks were published or proven empty).

fields.name: nextBoostDueWeek
docs: Earliest unprocessed boost tranche; zero means no future cash. Kept
through staging until the complete frozen set has been published.

fields.name: followingBoostDueWeek
docs: Minimum due strictly after next_week, rebuilt by every frozen stream
and every new post. Publication promotes it only after count equality.

fields.name: publicationCommitment
docs: Rolling digest of publication events; survives claim-set closure.

fields.name: carriedHolds
docs: At most one positive ordinary hold per original-age ring slot. Stored
on the heap during decoding; full capacity is prepaid once at init.

fields.name: lineage
docs: Rolling commitment to each delivered (lot, units, fee); events retain preimages.

fields.name: proposed
docs: Proposal only: no funds move, no reservation or nonexpiry is conferred.

fields.name: role
docs: 0 riders; 1 backers. Domain-separated in the §8 asset namespace.

fields.name: publishedRoles
docs: Anti-republication bits while the mint record exists. The permanent
hill cursor prevents this record's recreation after both roles close.

fields.name: hills
docs: Base58 hill identity UTF-8 order, NOT binary public-key order.

fields.name: scheduled
docs: Immutable integer schedule; each index ages from start_week + index.

types.name: CardType
docs: Type of Beetle Card - determines scope behavior

types.name: DistributionConfig
docs: Canonical distribution configuration (TOKENOMICS_V2).
The value remains in the instruction ABI for compatibility, but the program
accepts only this exact policy.

types.name: LeaderEntry
docs: Leaderboard entry for a vault

types.name: ProtocolParameters
docs: Protocol parameters stored in ProgramConfig.
The top-level constants remain the default launch values. ProgramConfig
stores the live values so future governance updates do not require a
program upgrade for routine economic tuning. The emission interval is an
immutable monetary-policy constant even though it remains in this legacy
aggregate ABI.

types.name: RecordContinuityPolicy
docs: Record continuity carried by a canon successor.

fields.name: commitmentHash
docs: SHA-256 of the exact D12 commitment. This is repeated as an argument so
Anchor can derive the PDA, then verified against program-built bytes.

types.name: Stage1CarriedHold
docs: One permanent cursor per hill/mint. In-order settlement makes each live
ring slot unambiguously the original week, never a refreshed hold age.

types.name: Stage1Ledger
docs: Available harvest and terminal pool are SUBSETS of held, not new income.
Cash is admitted once; fee withdrawal remains absent.

fields.name: ownerCustody
docs: Sum of lot.units + lot.owner_units, including exit partitions.

fields.name: sourceSnapshot
docs: Nonzero commitment to historical inventory, rates, owners and riding.

fields.name: payableRoleTotals
docs: Publisher-attested registered shares, bounded separately by each role.

fields.name: basis
docs: Ordinary then founding, each ordered 0/13/26/52 weeks. Sum per-lot
min(basis, floor(units*rate)); never floor aggregate units across lots.
